notes.subject: ne ka
notes.rationale: First-person suffix on משיחי and נביאי: 'my anointed, my prophets' — Yawe is the speaker.

notes.subject: Mashíaciw
notes.rationale: משיחי plural here: the patriarchs as 'my anointed ones', not a single Messianic figure.

notes.subject: aw
notes.rationale: Direct imperative address — Yawe's rebuke to kings who touched the fathers.

notes.subject: aw kana
notes.rationale: Two parallel negative imperatives structure the verse as a summons and warning.

translation: Aw kana ne ka Mashíaciw la tɛmɛ, aw kana ne ka nabiw ma jugu kɛ.
